scoringScale: 0=absent/failed, 1=severe deficiencies, 2=major workarounds, 3=acceptable, 4=strong, 5=excellent and proven in spike

criteria.label: Integration with existing Global Output Framework

candidates.name: A — TipTap Pages (official BLOCKED; community pagination prototype tested)
knockouts: Official Pages: BLOCKED — npm 404 without paid Tiptap subscription/private-registry token; every Pages capability remains DOCUMENTATION ONLY
Community pagination (tiptap-extension-pagination 2.1.4): peer-dep requires @tiptap/core ^2.11.5 — INCOMPATIBLE with ERP TipTap 3.27.1

notes.usability: Rich-text editing familiar; page canvas professional-looking in prototype. Score reflects existing Studio UX audit + prototype; official Pages UNTESTED.
notes.fidelity: Editor pagination is decoupled from the Gotenberg PDF renderer — no proven preview/PDF parity. Community ext: initial load NOT paginated until first edit (PROVEN defect).
notes.pagination: No intra-paragraph page splitting (whole paragraph moves, large bottom gaps — PROVEN); no table page-break management tested.
notes.arabic: Browser shapes Arabic natively BUT dir=rtl stripped by StarterKit schema — Arabic rendered LTR (PROVEN). Needs custom direction extensions.
notes.licensing: Pages requires Tiptap plan from $49/mo (annual) + private registry; community alternative ISC but v2-only.

candidates.name: B — Carbone community 3.8.2 + DOCX + Gotenberg LibreOffice

notes.usability: Word authoring is the most familiar admin tool; {d.x} markers learnable. HEURISTIC — templates in spike were built programmatically, not by a real admin in Word.
notes.fidelity: Word view ≈ LibreOffice PDF with FONT SUBSTITUTION differences (Liberation serif observed). Fidelity gate required per template.
notes.coverage: Letters/certs/salary PROVEN; 120-row loop report 11 pages PROVEN; fixed-layout cards weak (no absolute positioning tested).
notes.pagination: Word pagination engine + repeating tableHeader rows PROVEN through LibreOffice; manual page break PROVEN.
notes.arabic: Arabic shaping and RTL paragraphs CORRECT via LibreOffice (PROVEN, B2). Bidi mixed-run care needed.
notes.security: DOCX macro/zip-bomb risks require validation + sandboxed converter (Gotenberg container). Server-side injection only.
notes.licensing: CCL: free as embedded component of a value-added product (this ERP qualifies). Community v3 is one major version behind EE; DYNAMIC IMAGES (per-company logos from one template) are Enterprise-only — one template per company or server-side preprocessing needed.

candidates.name: C — pdfme 6.1.12 (MIT, pdf-lib based fixed layout)
knockouts: Arabic/RTL: maintainer states RTL is out of scope (pdfme PR #1300, Jan 2026); spike PROVED broken standalone Arabic text (faint/disconnected), bidi punctuation errors on ID card — KNOCKED OUT for any Arabic-bearing document family
Flowing documents: 18-paragraph letter compressed into one page at unreadable size — no reflow across pages (PROVEN, C4) — KNOCKED OUT for flowing letters

notes.usability: Drag-and-drop designer exists but was NOT hands-on tested in spike (generator only) — score capped and flagged.
notes.fidelity: Same JSON drives designer/preview/generator; BUT standalone text rendered hairline-faint with embedded Noto Arabic font across 3 independent rasterizers (PROVEN defect as configured).
notes.pagination: Table schema DOES auto-paginate (120 rows → 4 pages, PROVEN) but WITHOUT repeating header rows on continuation pages.
notes.performance: 34–270 ms in-process generation, no container dependency (PROVEN).

notes.usability: Developer-only. NO business-admin self-service — honest score per spike rules. Template Studio (structured blocks → EL) is the existing partial mitigation.
notes.fidelity: Same HTML → same Chromium for preview PNG and PDF — parity PROVEN across all 10 outputs.
notes.coverage: All 8 mandatory documents PROVEN including CR80 card (@page mm sizing), 10-page landscape report, full-RTL salary certificate.
notes.pagination: Repeating thead, totals, landscape, break control all PROVEN (D5 p2/p10).
notes.arabic: Shaped Arabic, full RTL direction, Arabic-Indic numerals, embedded WOFF2 fonts PROVEN. Minor care: LTR runs inside RTL sentences need bidi isolation.
notes.security: Existing RLS/permissions/protected-asset governance; two-company branding isolation PROVEN (D8A/D8B).
notes.performance: 234–842 ms per PDF via Gotenberg (PROVEN); requires Gotenberg container (already operated).
notes.migration: Zero migration — it is the live framework.
